text:
Mats Zuccarello is in his first season in Los Angeles after 452 games with Minnesota, and the 39-year-old is still finding his footing after missing time. The Kings' own site described Kevin Fiala and Zuccarello as "making strides in their returns to the Kings lineup" (LA Kings Insider), and the season line reads like a work in progress: three goals, one assist in 13 games.

That split is odd for a player who has always been a passer first. His three goals came on 1.81 expected goals, our measure of chance quality, so the finishing is running hot, and the assists are missing: he has none in his last ten games, against 5.7 expected points at his ice time. At five on five the Kings have had 44.3% of the expected goals with him on the ice, 6.35 points worse than without him. He is playing 15.6 minutes a night. Evolving-Hockey had him at 1.7 wins above replacement last season, 73rd of 401 forwards. Our numbers project 42 points, and the passing is what to watch.
headline: Zuccarello is scoring goals, just not making plays
